Character is EXACTLY the person in the photographs: slim young adult man, clean-shaven long oval face, thick dark eyebrows, dark eyes, prominent slender nose, LONG VOLUMINOUS dark brown CURLY hair to the shoulders, full crown of hair. His defining outfit stays on in all moves: open warm chocolate/cognac BROWN mid-thigh SHEARLING COAT with thick CREAM fluffy lapels/collar, cream turned cuffs, brown outer sleeves and short split coat tails; heather BLUE-GRAY quarter-zip knit sweater under the coat with small dark undershirt opening; fitted LIGHT WASH BLUE JEANS; BLACK ankle boots with small SILVER STUDS on toes and sides. Preserve face, hair volume and length, outfit, slender proportions; do not turn him into a bearded/bald fighter. Coat tails and curls follow motion.
Transparent game asset: true alpha0 outside body and inside gaps, no floor, cast shadow, text, logo, grid, props or opponent. Hands empty. All standing poses face RIGHT in 3/4 view, rotated falling poses may show head left feet right.
Strict regular THREE columns by TWO rows, total1536x1024, square512x512 cells. EXACTLY SIX chronological poses, top-left to bottom-right. Keep pose scale and logical root stable: neutral figure about420px high, crown aroundy50 and rear supportheel aroundx150,y470 within eachcell. Full body always inside cell, generous margin for curls and fists. Do not crop any boot, coat, fist or hair. Never independently centre each pose by visible bounding box. Final export six192x176cells so clear compact shapes are important.
Approved pixelmodel in input1 locks identity and outfit. Photograph2 reinforces likeness. Keep clear young clean-shaven face and full long shoulderlength CURLS, thick cream collar/cuffs on browncoat, lightjeans and studdedboots.
Six WALK-IN-GUARD poses for seamless WALKCYCLE toRIGHT, highfists.0leftbackfootplanted,rightfootforward;1rearfootpushandfrontfootroll;2passingphase backknee up frontfootbearingweight;3otherlegforward extended;4bothfeet alternateplant;5passingphase oppositeleg. Six DIFFERENT legpositions with counterrotation, no duplicates. Keepguardhigh, chestheightstable. Bootscontactsamebaseline, samebodyproportions.
